categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Jiuzhou Yigui Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the noise and vibration control industry, focusing on urban rail transit vibration and noise reduction technologies. Its main business includes research and development, manufacturing, engineering design, market promotion, testing consulting, and rail operation management engineering technology services. The company offers physical noise and vibration control products such as steel spring floating slab track systems, prefabricated steel spring floating slabs, rubber spring isolators, high-elasticity isolation pads, noise barriers, and vehicle equipment. Additionally, it provides intelligent monitoring and smart operation and maintenance systems based on sound fingerprint technology for rail transit infrastructure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include damping spring floating slab isolation systems with low natural frequency and high damping ratios, prefabricated floating slab track technology enabling efficient and environmentally friendly construction, and high-speed damping steel spring isolation technology for speeds up to 200 km/h. It also develops sound fingerprint online monitoring and smart operation systems integrating IoT, cloud computing, big data, and AI for real-time, full-domain monitoring of rail infrastructure. Production methods emphasize digitalization, automation, and intelligent manufacturing, including CNC machining and robotics, supported by ERP, MES, and OA systems for efficient production planning and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves urban rail transit owners and construction contractors, including major state-owned enterprises and infrastructure investment entities. Its products and services are applied in metro, light rail, suburban rail, and heavy freight rail projects across China. It also extends its technology to industrial, civil building, mechanical equipment, ship engineering, and cultural heritage protection sectors. The company’s market includes 33 cities with over 150 rail transit lines, covering new rail construction and existing line upgrades, with a market share exceeding 40% in the rail vibration and noise control sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant business in North China, East China, South China, Central China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast regions. Key cities include Beijing, Tianjin, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Zhengzhou, and others. It has established dual operational centers in Beijing and Guangzhou, with subsidiaries and offices in Shanghai, Shenzhen, Zhengzhou, and other provincial capitals. The company is also exploring international markets, participating in overseas metro project bids and planning global expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Jiuzhou Yigui operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It develops and manufactures specialized vibration and noise control products and provides integrated technical consulting, engineering design, installation, and smart operation and maintenance services. The company manages procurement of raw materials like steel springs and components, often customized for specific projects, and maintains a qualified supplier system. It delivers products and services directly to rail transit owners and contractors, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the rail infrastructure vibration and noise control ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing intelligent operation and maintenance systems using sound fingerprint technology, integrating AI, big data, IoT, and cloud computing to enable real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance of rail infrastructure. It emphasizes R&D in high-speed damping technologies, prefabricated track systems, and multi-functional monitoring equipment. The company actively builds an engineering technology center to support industry standards and innovation, pursues cross-sector technology applications, and invests in talent acquisition and organizational optimization to drive digital transformation and sustainable growth. It also aims to expand into green low-carbon services and international markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of vibration and noise control equipment such as steel spring floating slab systems, prefabricated floating slabs, noise barriers, and related components. The company also earns income from technical consulting, engineering design, installation services, and smart operation and maintenance system sales. Contracts are typically project-based, acquired via bidding or competitive negotiation, with pricing determined per project. The company maintains a direct sales model supported by a nationwide marketing and after-sales network, focusing on both new rail construction and existing line upgrades.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Beijing Jiuzhou Yigui holds a leading position in the Chinese urban rail transit vibration and noise control market, with a market share exceeding 40%. It has broken foreign technology monopolies by developing proprietary damping spring floating slab technologies and related products. The company is recognized for its strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product portfolio, and integrated service offerings. It competes with both domestic and international firms in the rail infrastructure vibration control sector, leveraging its technological innovation, extensive project experience, and strategic partnerships with government and industry stakeholders to maintain industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 359 million, representing a 30.7% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 11.15 million, a significant growth of 773.15% compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 1.47 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.27 billion. It maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by increased project deliveries, cost control, and reduced investment losses. The company has a robust order backlog of approximately RMB 674 million as of year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its proprietary sound fingerprint online monitoring technology and integrated smart operation and maintenance systems, enabling real-time, full-domain monitoring and predictive maintenance of rail infrastructure. Its products offer high damping efficiency, long fatigue life, and environmental benefits such as prefabricated construction reducing onsite pollution. The company provides comprehensive, customized vibration and noise control solutions covering the entire project lifecycle, supported by strong R&D, extensive patents, and industry-leading standards development. Its dual focus on physical noise control and intelligent data-driven services creates a unique competitive edge in the evolving rail transit market.
